card.name: Answer-choice letters in quiz questions
card.fires_on: The letter b (or c) that labels the next option in a multiple-choice list, right after the previous option's text. Seen in a quiz about To Kill a Mockingbird.

modes.label: Next option letter
modes.description: The letter b or c marking the following choice after an option's text.
modes.example: c. Rover d. Scout 6. Mr. Dolphus Raymond gave Dill a drink of what to settle his stomach? a. whiskey<< b>>. Coca-Cola c. root beer d

modes.label: True/false options
modes.description: The letter b following a true choice.
